info.name: Credly Web Service Badge Templates Events API

params.name: organization_id
params.description: The ID of the issuing organization.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of paginated results.

items.docs: Returns a paginated feed of organization events. Event types include badge.created, badge.deleted, badge.privacy.changed, and badge.state.changed. Returns at most 50 results per page; use the page parameter for more. These are the same events delivered via webhooks. (confirmed)
